portal_description:
Keylime is a TPM based highly scalable remote boot attestation and runtime integrity measurement solution.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* keylime no longer supports the workaround to use TPMs with malformed EK certificate [rhel-9.7.z] (JIRA:RHEL-111244)
